get.summary: That the API answers. Anybody may ask.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Asks for a password reset to be sent to an email address. Anybody may ask; the answer is the same whether or not a person has that address.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Sets a new password with the code a reset message carried. The code is good once.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Signs a back-office or outside user in with their email address and password, and their authenticator code where they have one. The tokens are set as cookies; the answer holds none.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Gives a session a new access token and a new refresh token. A refresh token is good once: one presented a second time ends its session.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Ends the session on the server and clears its cookies.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.
A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The CSRF value of the session the refresh token belongs to, for a page that was loaded anew.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: The signed-in person sets a new password, giving their current one. Their other sessions end.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Begins setting up the signed-in person’s authenticator: answers the secret for the app. Nothing is kept until a code proves it.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Finishes setting up the signed-in person’s authenticator with a code from it. Their other sessions end.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin clears another person’s authenticator. Their sessions end; it is a security event.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin creates an admin, a manager/analyst or a read-only viewer (a client user, a contractor user with its contractor, or an auditor). Never a monitor. The person has no password until an admin sets one.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The firm’s people, a page at a time, in the order they were added: those in service, or the archived ones. A monitor’s phone number is in an admin’s answer only.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: One person, as an admin or a manager/analyst reads them. A monitor’s phone number is in an admin’s answer only.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

patch.summary: An admin changes a person’s name, email address or phone number, and a read-only viewer’s kind, contractor and whether they see private citizens by name. Only what is stated changes. A changed sign-in address is told to the old one where the firm has mail.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

put.summary: An admin states the permissions a manager/analyst holds from now on. One taken away refuses that person’s very next request.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

put.summary: An admin states the projects a read-only viewer sees from now on. One not named is taken away.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin sets a person’s password. Their sessions end, and they set one of their own at their next sign-in.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin ends every session a person has open.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin archives a person. Their sessions end and they are refused at once. The only admin can’t be archived.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

put.summary: An admin makes a manager/analyst an admin, or an admin a manager/analyst. Their very next request is asked as the new role. The only admin stays one; a monitor’s and a read-only viewer’s role never changes.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin takes a person out of the archive. They are in service again with what they held, and sign in again; refused while somebody in service signs in with their email address.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The firm’s clients whose name holds what was typed; none archived.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a client: the jurisdiction or agency paying for the work.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The declaration events whose name or reference holds what was typed; none archived.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a declaration event: the disaster and its reference as written, its reference type picked from the firm’s list.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a project under a client and a declaration event, with its time zone, active window, ticket-number source, ticket types and kinds of unit rate work.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

patch.summary: Changes a project’s own settings; one left out stays as it is. Its tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

patch.summary: Changes a project’s active window: either end; the end may be emptied. Its tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Closes a project: the mark and its time. Nothing under it is deleted or refused after.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Starts a number series the project doesn’t have yet (its cert numbers), from the number the firm says.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Enters a run of pre-printed control tickets on a project that numbers its tickets from them.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Takes off a control range entered by mistake. It is archived, never deleted.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a field tag at the end of the project’s own list.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The firm’s contractors whose name holds what was typed; none archived.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a contractor record, firm-wide. Whoever adds it says its kind.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a contractor to a project as a prime.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a contract on a project: its name, one of the project’s primes, and an optional link to the signed copy.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a debris type to the firm’s library, named as its contracts name the work.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a payable type to the firm’s list: the work a pay item prices.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Creates a project’s form for one document type. "GPS required" is stated on an ROE form, and what an incident offers its monitors on an incident form; on no other.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Adds a debris type from the firm’s library to a load or haul-out form. One not marked Reduced on a haul-out form is saved with a warning.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Saves the firm’s own fields on an ROE, survey, incident or drop-off log form as its next version. A version is never edited.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Enters a pay item read off the contract: its code, unique on the project, its description, payable type, Unit of Measure, size band, capture settings, and a rate for each prime. A band that overlaps another of its payable type isn’t saved. The project’s tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

patch.summary: Changes a pay item: its code, description, Unit of Measure, size band, crew-time conversion or capture settings; one left out stays as it is. The rules its "Pays when" wrote are renamed with it. The project’s tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

put.summary: Sets a prime’s rate on a pay item: for the first time, changed (audited with the rate before), or put back. The project’s tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

put.summary: Saves a pay item’s "Pays when": for each form it pays on, the criteria and the transaction # it adds. A rule is written and kept for each of the project’s contracts whose prime has a rate on it; the answer says which rules were added, changed, archived and left alone.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Writes a rule on one of the project’s load, haul-out or unit rate forms. An exact copy of another rule isn’t saved. Its form’s tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

put.summary: States a rule anew, whole: its form, name, contract, Active tick, criteria and actions. A rule a pay item’s "Pays when" wrote is changed only there. The tickets of its form, and of the form it had, not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Merges a sub typed twice at certification into the contractor that is kept: the kept one takes its place on each project, the certifications that named it name the kept one, and it is archived. The tickets of those certifications not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Enters a disposal site on a project: its site type, the four site facts, its GPS, a permit number (empty: permit outstanding) and its dates. "Haul-outs leave here" is saved only on a TDSR/DMS site.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

patch.summary: Changes a site: its name, short code, site type, site facts, permit number, GPS or dates; one left out stays as it is. The tickets with a field event at the site not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Saves a site’s own shape as its next version: from then on the site is checked against the shape in place of the project’s circle, and an earlier shape stays as it was. The tickets with a field event at the site not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Links a site to a tipping fee pay item written from it: how a fee line is told from a hauling line. A site may keep several.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: Loads a project’s map as its next version: its boundary and, if it has any, its zones, each named in the field picked. An earlier version and its zones stay as they were. The project’s tickets not locked as invoiced are queued.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The setup check: everything a project’s setup leaves open, in plain words; none when it is whole. It lists and never refuses.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: What each site’s phones ask for: the load call, the scale weight, a count of the items carried or nothing more, for each site, debris type and prime. Worked out from the setup as it stands.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: What one site’s phones ask for: its rows of the project’s quantity lookup.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

get.summary: The firm’s phones, a page at a time, in the order they were enrolled: those in service, or those taken out of it. Each says which version of the master passcode’s check it holds.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: A phone is taken out of service, as lost or retired, from this moment. Its record is kept; what it made later is received and flagged, never refused. Refused for a phone already out of service.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.

post.summary: An admin changes the firm’s master passcode, giving their own password again. A new version is kept, as a slow hash only; each phone’s check moves to it at its next sync. Refused for a passcode under 8 or over 128 characters, or known from breaches.

default.description: A refusal or a failure: a plain code and the request’s id.
